remarks: Charming 3-bedroom Darien colonial on quiet cul-de-sac offers 2,064 sf of beautifully appointed living space on a lush 0.52-acre parcel with large rear private patio with a low maintenance setting with tasteful landscaping. Inside the home flows effortlessly, with a spacious living room featuring hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. The heart of the home - an open kitchen with center island that seamlessly connects to the dining area and sliders that provides easy access to outdoor entertaining. A flexible upstairs Family room is ideal for a home office, playroom or media lounge.  Retreat upstairs to the three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a primary suite graced with hardwood floors and ample natural light, and two adult sized secondary bedrooms. Two full baths and a half bath ensure comfort and convenience for family and guests.  Practical features include central laundry (off the kitchen), garage with automatic opener, and efficient zoned heating powered by propane and Central AC. The home sits on a quaint street with a level lot yet conveniently close to Goodwives Shopping Center, Trader Joe's, Downtown Darien, and the train - Perfect for daily life or commuting.  Located in the sought-after Darien school district (Tokeneke Elementary, Middlesex Middle, and Darien High), this picture-perfect home embodies the ideal blend of elegance, comfort, and convenience. A rare opportunity to move right into a gorgeous home in a wonderful neighborhood!!
